nodes.name: Execute Workflow Trigger
nodes.notes: Ye workflow Module 1.5 (Central CRM Sync) ke 'Execute Workflow - 2.1 Outreach' node se call hota hai jab lead stage = Qualified ho jaata hai. Input: odoo_lead_id, name, email, phone, company, current_stage.

parameters.query: SELECT * FROM clients_master WHERE odoo_lead_id = {{$json.odoo_lead_id}} LIMIT 1;

nodes.name: Fetch Lead Detail
nodes.notes: service_type, intent_summary, score jaisi details yahan se milti hain taaki outreach message personalized ho (1.3/1.4 me already save ho chuki hain).

nodes.name: Send WhatsApp (Waha)
nodes.notes: Waha ka /api/sendText endpoint aur auth header version ke hisaab se thoda differ kar sakta hai - https://waha.devlike.pro/docs ki official API reference se confirm kar lena. Agar lead ka phone number nahi hai to ye node skip ho jaayega (empty result, error nahi).

nodes.name: Odoo - Create LinkedIn Task (Semi-Automated)
nodes.notes: LinkedIn par direct automated messaging LinkedIn ke Terms of Service ke against hai aur account ban ka risk hai. Isliye ye step LinkedIn message khud nahi bhejta - Ollama-drafted message ke saath Odoo me ek activity/task bana deta hai jise sales rep 1-click me copy-paste karke manually LinkedIn par bhej sakta hai. Agar aap apna khud ka LinkedIn automation tool (jaise Unipile/PhantomBuster - apne risk par) use karna chahte ho to yahan HTTP node replace kar sakte ho.

parameters.query:
UPDATE clients_master
SET status = 'Contacted',
    last_outreach_at = now(),
    updated_at = now()
WHERE odoo_lead_id = {{$json.odoo_lead_id}};

nodes.name: Postal Inbound Reply Webhook
nodes.notes: Postal me Settings > Webhooks me 'MessageBounced'/'MessageDeliveryFailed' ke alawa inbound route bhi configure karo taaki reply aane par ye URL call ho. Postal docs: https://docs.postalserver.io/

nodes.name: Mark Lead as Replied
nodes.notes: Postal ka inbound webhook payload field name (from/mail_from) apne Postal version ke actual payload se confirm kar lena test email bhej ke.
